arguments.command:
python -c "
from glom import Auto, Fill, Iter, Let, Invoke, ROOT, consts, constants, Coalesce, Check, Assign

# Test all reprs
print('Auto repr:', repr(Auto()))
print('Fill repr:', repr(Fill('x')))
print('Fill repr2:', repr(Fill('x', default=42)))
print('Iter repr:', repr(Iter('x')))
print('Let repr:', repr(Let('x', a='b')))
print('Let repr2:', repr(Let('x')))
print('Invoke repr:', repr(Invoke(str)))
print('Invoke repr2:', repr(Invoke(str, args=(1,), kwargs={'key': 'val'})))
print('ROOT repr:', repr(ROOT)))
print('consts repr:', repr(consts))
print('constants repr:', repr(constants))
print('Coalesce repr:', repr(Coalesce('a', 'b')))
print('Coalesce repr2:', repr(Coalesce('a', 'b', default='c')))
print('Check repr:', repr(Check('spec')))
print('Assign repr:', repr(Assign('a', 1)))
"
